# crease/ui

> The shadcn/ui design language rebuilt as source-owned Foldkit components. No React or JSX.

## Primary documentation

- Architecture: /docs/architecture.md
- Registry installation: /docs/registry.md
- Create presets: /docs/create-presets.md
- Component parity: /docs/component-parity.md
- Machine-readable component index: /docs-index.json
- Complete API inventory: /llms-full.txt

## Components

- Accordion: /docs/components/accordion — install with `npx shadcn@latest add Potti1234/creaseui/accordion`
- Alert Dialog: /docs/components/alert-dialog — install with `npx shadcn@latest add Potti1234/creaseui/alert-dialog`

## API inventory

### Accordion

A shadcn-styled Accordion component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/accordion.ts`

Examples: Basic, Multiple, Disabled, Borders, Card, RTL

- `AccordionType: value` (value)
- `AccordionType = typeof AccordionType.Type` (type)
- `Model: value` (value)
- `Model = typeof Model.Type` (type)
- `GotDisclosureMessage: value` (value)
- `Message: value` (value)
- `Message = typeof Message.Type` (type)
- `ToggledItem: value` (value)
- `OutMessage: value` (value)
- `OutMessage = typeof OutMessage.Type` (type)
- `AccordionInitItem = Readonly<{ value: string; isOpen?: boolean; }>` (type)
- `InitConfig = Readonly<{ id: string; type?: AccordionType; items: ReadonlyArray<AccordionInitItem>; }>` (type)
- `init(config: InitConfig): Model` (function)
- `update(model: Model, message: Message): UpdateReturn` (function)
- `AccordionItem = Readonly<{ value: string; trigger: Html | string; content: Html | string; isDisabled?: boolean; }>` (type)
- `AccordionProps<Msg> = Readonly<{ model: Model; toParentMessage: (message: Message) => Msg; items: ReadonlyArray<AccordionItem>; class?: string; itemClass?: string; triggerClass?: string; contentClass?: string; }>` (type)
- `accordion<Msg>(props: AccordionProps<Msg>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Alert Dialog

A shadcn-styled Alert Dialog component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/alert-dialog.ts`

Examples: Basic, Small, Media, Small with Media, Destructive, RTL

- `Model: value` (value)
- `Model = typeof Model.Type` (type)
- `Message: value` (value)
- `Message = typeof Message.Type` (type)
- `OutMessage: value` (value)
- `OutMessage = typeof OutMessage.Type` (type)
- `init: value` (value)
- `update: value` (value)
- `open: value` (value)
- `close: value` (value)
- `AlertDialogSlots = Readonly<{ closeButton: ReadonlyArray<ChildAttribute>; }>` (type)
- `AlertDialogProps<Msg> = Readonly<{ model: Model; toParentMessage: (message: Message) => Msg; title: string; description?: string; media?: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; actionLabel: string; cancelLabel?: string; size?: 'default' | 'sm'; actionClass?: string; c…` (type)
- `alertDialog<Msg>(props: AlertDialogProps<Msg>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Alert

A shadcn-styled Alert component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/alert.ts`

Examples: Basic, Destructive, Action, Custom Colors, RTL

- `alertVariants: value` (value)
- `AlertVariants = VariantProps<typeof alertVariants>` (type)
- `AlertProps = Slot & Readonly<{ variant?: AlertVariants['variant']; }>` (type)
- `alert<Msg>(props: AlertProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `alertTitle<Msg>(props: Slot, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `alertDescription<Msg>(props: Slot, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Aspect Ratio

A shadcn-styled Aspect Ratio component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/aspect-ratio.ts`

Examples: Basic, Square, Portrait, RTL

- `AspectRatioProps = Readonly<{ ratio: number; class?: string; children: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; }>` (type)
- `aspectRatio<Msg>(props: AspectRatioProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Attachment

A shadcn-styled Attachment component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/attachment.ts`

Examples: Basic, Image, States, Sizes, Group, Trigger

- `attachmentVariants: value` (value)
- `AttachmentState = 'idle' | 'uploading' | 'processing' | 'error' | 'done'` (type)
- `attachment<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps & Readonly<{ state?: AttachmentState; size?: VariantProps<typeof attachmentVariants>['size']; orientation?: VariantProps<typeof attachmentVariants>['orientation']; }>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentMedia<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps & Readonly<{ variant?: 'icon' | 'image' }>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentContent<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentActions<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentGroup<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentTitle<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentDescription<Msg>(props: ChildrenProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `attachmentTrigger<Msg>(props: Readonly<{ onClick: Msg; label: string; class?: string }>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Avatar

A shadcn-styled Avatar component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/avatar.ts`

Examples: Basic, Badge, Badge with Icon, Avatar Group, Avatar Group Count, Avatar Group with Icon, Sizes, Dropdown, RTL

- `Model: value` (value)
- `Model = typeof Model.Type` (type)
- `Loaded: value` (value)
- `Failed: value` (value)
- `Message: value` (value)
- `Message = typeof Message.Type` (type)
- `init(): Model` (function)
- `update(_model: Model, message: Message): Model` (function)
- `AvatarProps = Readonly<{ size?: 'default' | 'sm' | 'lg'; class?: string; children: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; }>` (type)
- `avatar<Msg>(props: AvatarProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `AvatarImageProps = Readonly<{ src: string; alt: string; class?: string; model?: Model; }>` (type)
- `avatarImage<Msg>(props: AvatarImageProps & Readonly<{ toParentMessage?: (message: Message) => Msg }>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)
- `AvatarFallbackProps = Readonly<{ class?: string; children: ReadonlyArray<Html | string>; model?: Model; }>` (type)
- `avatarFallback<Msg>(props: AvatarFallbackProps, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

- `Message: value` (value)
- `Message = typeof Message.Type` (type)
- `OutMessage: value` (value)
- `OutMessage<Value extends string = string> = ComboboxPrimitive.OutMessage<Value>` (type)
- `init: value` (value)
- `create: value` (value)
- `update: value` (value)
- `ComboboxSize = 'sm' | 'default'` (type)
- `ComboboxItemConfig = Readonly<{ content?: Html | string; searchText?: string; class?: string; isDisabled?: boolean; }>` (type)
- `ComboboxProps<Item, Value extends string, Msg> = Readonly<{ model: Model; maybeSelectedValue: Option.Option<Value>; restingInputValue: string; toParentMessage: (message: Message) => Msg; items: ReadonlyArray<Item>; itemToValue: (item: Item) => Value; itemToLa…` (type)
- `combobox<Item, Value extends string, Msg>(props: ComboboxProps<Item, Value, Msg>, h: HtmlBuilder<Msg>): Html` (function)

### Command

A shadcn-styled Command component for Foldkit.

Source: `src/ui/command.ts`

Examples: Basic, Shortcuts, Groups, Scrollable, RTL

- `Model: value` (value)
- `Model = typeof Model.Type` (type)
- `Message: value` (value)
- `Message = typeof Message.Type` (type)
- `OutMessage: value` (value)
- `OutMessage<Item extends string = string> = ComboboxPrimitive.OutMessage<Item>` (type)
- `init: value` (value)
- `create: value` (value)
